papers_reviewed.title: Downside Risk Reduction Using Regime-Switching Signals: A Statistical Jump Model Approach
papers_reviewed.authors: Yizhan Shu, Chenyu Yu, John M. Mulvey
papers_reviewed.relevance_notes: Statistical Jump Model outperforms HMM for regime detection by adding jump penalty enforcing regime persistence. Tested US/German/Japanese equities 1990-2023. Directly applicable to H165 (macro-regime gate) and H205-B (bear-regime BAB). Higher confidence regime labels = fewer false BIL exits on monthly-rebalance strategies.

papers_reviewed.title: Toward Expert Investment Teams: A Multi-Agent LLM System with Fine-Grained Trading Tasks
papers_reviewed.authors: Kunihiro Miyazaki, Takanobu Kawahara, Stephen Roberts, Stefan Zohren
papers_reviewed.relevance_notes: Fine-grained task decomposition in multi-agent LLM improves risk-adjusted returns vs coarse-grained designs. Tested on Japanese equities — not directly applicable to US large-cap universe. No open-source code. Interesting for H209 AlphaCrafter comparison but not immediately actionable.
papers_reviewed.staged_reason: Japanese market only; no implementation available; H209 already queued for AlphaCrafter
